B41_line: \idrow{B41}\par 共享分辨率的高维重叠混合 & $\nu_{n,J}=\allowbreak \sum_{r<J}p_r\mu_{q_r,0}^{\otimes n}$；先混合完整 n 维源，再平滑截断；$q_r=2^r$。 & 含晶格 $n^{1/4}$ 基线；12 项真实有限尺度测试未得到新渐近下界。 & $\mathcal W(\allowbreak \sum_rp_rf_r)\le2[1+H(p)]\max_r\mathcal W(f_r)$；均匀 J 层相对增益至多 $O(\log J)$。组件最优阶未知。\\[0.65em]
support: [0,64)^n; finite full original source, components merged at identical sites; total distinct source atoms 256^n
lambda_formula: log_lambda=-n log64; fixed before any production energy
radial: omega uniform normalized cone faces [-1,1]^n; x=z+r omega/2; r=exp(t/n),t in [0,nlog2]
winner: global continuous full-side R in [1,2] via ALL component coordinate arrivals/endpoints; equal arrival groups completed
microbox_bound: For each component each coordinate: <=floor((2/n) q_j)+1 gridpoints, further 0 if Q interval empty; product and sum mixture weights. At n>=16 all counts <=1, so this equals product of per-coordinate min(c_ji,1).
uncertainty: No FIRST/gates/actualgeom. Floating near-score/band/delay tolerance (n+1)*1e-10; screened lower and unknown-retaining upper profiles. Not interval certificates. Finite-node MC bounds do not control quadrature. No order fit.
